span.label: **THE PAPER THAT MADE PRIMING A MEMORY SYSTEM, AND IT SAYS HOW RECENT THAT WAS:** `Quotation withheld.` **Not an effect, not a task - a system.** Most of this corpus inherits that framing without arguing for it; this is where it was argued, and the `only recently` is the authors dating their own claim
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE SPLIT INSIDE THE WORD, MADE IN 1990 BY THE PEOPLE WHO OWNED IT:** `priming is an expression of a PERCEPTUAL REPRESENTATION SYSTEM that operates at a PRE-SEMANTIC level ... Quotation withheld.` **Two phenomena under one term, separated by naming the systems rather than the tasks.** This is Q-806's one-name-many-concepts problem being SOLVED inside a discipline - and it is worth the corpus noting that the solution was to split the referent and keep the word, which is exactly what soil science and psychology have not done with `priming effect`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE ARGUMENT FOR A NEW SYSTEM IS TAXONOMIC, NOT EXPERIMENTAL:** `Quotation withheld.` A new system is established by showing it sits between two accepted ones and belongs to neither. **That is why this paper is cited by records in this corpus that share no method with it** - the claim is about how to carve the field, and a carving can be adopted by anyone
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: **AND THE UNAWARENESS IS OF THE MEMORY, NOT OF THE STIMULUS - WHICH IS A DIFFERENT CLAIM FROM EVERY MASKED-PRIMING RECORD HERE:** `Quotation withheld.` dehaene1998, Finkbeiner2011 and hesselmann2016 all work to make the STIMULUS unavailable to report. **Tulving and Schacter are saying the stimulus is seen perfectly well and its status as a memory is what goes unnoticed.** Two senses of `nonconscious priming` that the corpus has been filing under one heading

span.label: priming —operationalised-as→ perceptual representation system
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — **`IS AN EXPRESSION OF` IS THE PAPER'S OWN VERB AND IT IS DOING SYSTEM-ASSIGNMENT.** The observable (priming) is assigned to a posited system (PRS), which is what `operationalised-as` records in reverse - here the construct is the system and the measure is the priming. Weight 0.9: `Evidence is converging for the proposition that` is the abstract's own framing, so this is a proposal with support rather than a demonstrated identity, and the rigidity clause in the quote is the property offered as the test.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: priming —distinct-from→ semantic memory
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — **THE `however` IS THE EDGE.** Perceptual priming is PRS and pre-semantic; conceptual priming is NOT - it runs on semantic memory. So the term covers two systems and the paper says which is which. Weight 0.9 and `seems to be` is inside the quote. **This is the single most useful row in the record for this project**, because it is a discipline splitting its own term deliberately, which is the move Q-806 found soil science and psychology have never made.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: priming —contrasted-with→ procedural memory
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — DEFINITION BY DOUBLE RESEMBLANCE: like procedural memory in one respect, like semantic memory in another, and identical to neither. The quote carries both halves, which is why it grounds a `contrasted-with` rather than an `is-a`. Weight 0.9 - this is the paper's taxonomic argument stated compactly, and it is the form of argument that makes the paper citable by people who never ran a priming experiment.
